modules: Sources Of Information For Feasibility Studies
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to specify the details of the work that is to be performed and any special conditions or skills involved in performing the job."
Job description is used to specify the details of the work that is to be performed and any special conditions or skills involved in performing the job.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common approach used to gather market information."
Interviewing or surveying is the most common approach used to gather market information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the means, methods, or plans that will be used by the entrepreneur to produce appropriate product or service for the business."
The marketing strategies are the means, methods, or plans that will be used by the entrepreneur to produce appropriate product or service for the business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of the business plan."
The business description is an integral part of the business plan.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount of funds which belong to the owner (the entrepreneur) of the business."
iii) Owner Equity The owner equity is the amount of funds which belong to the owner (the entrepreneur) of the business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of dividing the market into small homogeneous groups."
Market segmentation is the process of dividing the market into small homogeneous groups.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financing method involving an interest-bearing instrument."
Debt Financing Debt financing is a financing method involving an interest-bearing instrument.
